text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my...! With less than a year of 
practice, 
to bring it together to this degree is 
quite impressive...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. The Shinme and Tsunade-san 
must have devoted themselves 
wholeheartedly to their training.

One by one, the horsegirls demonstrated 
the rituals 
they were tasked with. And next――

――One, two, and three. 
With powerful strides, she cleared the 
towering obstacles.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
How was it? What did you think? 
How was Boo's Soaring Gallop?!
choice_data_list: That was your best performance yet!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! 
Boo was thinking the exact same thing!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
I was able to deliver my absolute best 
performance―― 
all because of you!

I firmly grasp the hand 
that Blast Onepiece extends to me.

As long as we keep working alongside the 
Shinme horsegirls like this, 
the festival is sure to be a success.
